Why this exists

I made Little Sparks for my wife during her pregnancy.

We believe solving puzzles is a wonderful little workout for the brain — even for a brain that’s still busy growing.

Our baby had more important things to do, like growing toes and developing a personality, so naturally, Mom had to do the thinking for two.

The least I could do was make sure she had a fresh puzzle waiting for her every day. So I put together a little collection of daily puzzles, tiny challenges, and brain teasers — something fun to keep her curious, smiling, and thinking.

A small gift for Mom. A little workout for the brain. And, hopefully, a head start for our tiny genius.

♡ Created with love from Devansh
